hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(printf %s "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty" 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$FILE" == *.rs ]]; then cd /opt/repos/view && bash .claude/hooks/post-edit-rs.sh "$FILE"; fi'

echo 'COMPACTION REMINDER: re-read .claude/CLAUDE.md. nvim is the sole buffer owner. Only view-tui touches the terminal; only view-engine speaks RPC; view-core is pure. Plans index: .claude/plans/INDEX.md. Never push.'
echo 'REMINDER: drain .claude/known-bugs.md before declaring done. Verify claims by running task ci, never by assumption.'
